product_title: Handcrafted Shubh Lotus Pearl Door Hanging Set
product_description: Enhance your home entrance with this beautiful handcrafted Shubh Lotus door hanging set. Featuring vibrant pink circular designs, elegant golden Shubh lettering, a traditional pink lotus motif, golden bead borders, and delicate pearl tassels, these decorative hangings bring auspicious charm and festive elegance to your space. Perfect for decorating main doors, pooja rooms, living spaces, and entrances during Diwali, weddings, housewarming ceremonies, and other special occasions. A beautiful blend of traditional Indian aesthetics and handcrafted detailing.
product_care_suggestion: Gently clean with a soft, dry cloth to remove dust.
Avoid water, moisture, and harsh cleaning chemicals to protect the fabric and decorative elements.
Keep away from prolonged direct sunlight to preserve the vibrant pink colour and golden finish.
Handle the pearl tassels and golden embellishments carefully to prevent tangling or damage.
Store in a dry place in a protective box or fabric bag when not in use.
